notes.subject: עלמות
notes.rationale: Sapos i min 'soprano/ol ses bilong singsing' o 'ol yangpela meri' — ol tanim tok i no wankain

notes.subject: למנצח
notes.gloss: tok bilong man i lukautim singsing — em i tok bilong hed tasol, ol i renda olsem pasin

notes.subject: hed bilong pes
notes.rationale: ves em i hed bilong pes, em i tok bilong ol man i makim singsing

translation: Long bilong man i lukautim singsing, long ol pikinini bilong Korah, long ol olpela meri, singsing.

tokens.gloss: long bilong man i lukautim singsing
